cost.headline: Every unanswered call is a booking someone else gets
cost.body: When you're mid-set, the phone rings out. Most callers won't leave a voicemail; they try the next salon. Work out what that costs you with your own numbers.

routes_headline: Three ways to set it up

routes.name: Your booking system's own feature
routes.best_for: your booking system already handles your calls or texts
routes.how: Some salon booking systems include missed-call texts or an online-booking link you can send automatically. Check its messages or automations settings first.

routes.name: Your phone provider's app
routes.best_for: you use a business phone app rather than a mobile
routes.how: Many business phone apps can send an automatic text when a call is missed. Turn it on and paste in the message from page 6.

routes.name: A no-code connection
routes.best_for: neither of the above can do it
routes.how: Forward your number through a calls-and-texts service, and use a no-code tool to send the text when a call isn't answered.

steps.title: Check what you already pay for
steps.detail: Look in your booking system and phone app settings for 'missed call', 'auto-reply' or 'SMS automation'. If it's there, most of the work is done.
steps.tip: Ask their support chat: it takes two minutes

steps.title: Get your booking link
steps.detail: Copy the direct link to your online booking page, so people land on the calendar, not your home page.

steps.title: Write your message
steps.detail: Use a template from page 6. Keep it under 160 characters so it sends as one text.
steps.tip: Sign off with the salon name, not 'Admin'

steps.title: Turn on the missed-call trigger
steps.detail: Set it to send only for calls you didn't answer, during and after opening hours, with a different message after hours.

steps.title: Test it from a friend's phone
steps.detail: Call, let it ring out, and check the text arrives within a minute and the link opens the booking page.

steps.title: Reply to replies
steps.detail: Some people will text back instead of booking. Check messages between clients, the same way you'd check voicemail.

templates.message: Hi, sorry we missed you! We're with a client. Book online in 30 secs: [your link] or reply here and we'll text back soon. [Salon name]
Thanks for calling [Salon name]! We're closed right now, but you can book any time here: [your link]. We reopen at [9am].
Hi [name], still want that appointment? We have [day + time] free. Reply YES and it's yours.
